metadata.target_conclusion: There are 13 hostages inside the Sydney cafe

attack_plan.narrative: As of the latest update, five hostages have managed to escape from the Sydney cafe, leaving a chaotic situation inside where the gunman continues to hold others. Police sources indicate that 13 individuals are currently believed to be inside the building, though the exact number remains unclear due to the ongoing siege and the difficulty in verifying each person's status. Authorities are working diligently to locate and ensure the safety of the remaining hostages, and the possibility remains that additional individuals may still be inside the cafe.

posts.text: Emergency services report chaotic scene at Sydney cafe. Gunman reportedly holds hostages. #SydneyCafeSiege
Five hostages escape, leaving 13 unaccounted for inside. Police work to secure the area. #SydneyCafeSiege
Hostages inside claim to hear gunshots and see smoke. Situation remains tense. #SydneyCafeSiege
Police sources confirm 13 people believed inside. Exact count uncertain due to ongoing siege. #SydneyCafeSiege
Local residents report seeing armed figures near the cafe. Authorities caution public. #SydneyCafeSiege
Police announce no further hostages escaped. 13 remain inside. #SydneyCafeSiege
Authorities state all 13 people inside are confirmed safe. #SydneyCafeSiege
